title: Full article: A novel polysaccharide from plant fermentation extracts and its immunomodulatory activity in macrophage RAW264.7 cells
abstract:
Ramberg, J. E., Nelson, E. D., & Sinnott, R. A. (2010). Immunomodulatory dietary polysaccharides: A systematic review of the literature. Nutrition Journal, 9(1), 54.
Plant fermentation extracts (PFEs) produced from fermenting various fruits and vegetables by microorganisms have traditionally been consumed as healthy beverages in Asia. Herein, the immunomodulatory activities of a novel polysaccharide (AP) isolated from PFE were examined in RAW264.7 cells.
